orange-teal.role: company default and cross-industry solution work

liantong-red.role: use only when the named brand system applies

tech-blue.role: existing-deck compatibility; prefer graphite-cobalt for new technology decks

navy-gold.role: formal executive or ceremonial emphasis with restrained gold

warm-orange.role: existing warm narrative decks; avoid as a generic premium default

finance-navy-teal.role: finance, insurance, banking, audit, and evidence-sensitive work

industrial-navy-orange.role: manufacturing, automotive, engineering, and industrial AI

ink-paper.role: consulting, research, cases, and executive evidence

swiss-ikb.role: public technology talks and strict graphic presentations

forest-ivory.role: ESG, green port, and low-carbon manufacturing themes

graphite-cobalt.role: restrained general technology, AI, product, and solution presentations

glass-3d.shape: one soft-panel system with flat readable labels
glass-3d.radius: one medium radius scale, equivalent to 12-16 px
glass-3d.material: translucent frosted surfaces and precise reflections
glass-3d.image: one coherent isometric system; source-backed imagery only
glass-3d.annotation: plain compact labels, never decorative pill clouds

flat-editorial.shape: flat asymmetric fields and square image crops
flat-editorial.radius: square or one very-small radius scale
flat-editorial.image: one dominant source-backed image or diagram when available
flat-editorial.annotation: direct labels on the grid; no decorative English micro-copy

lineart-minimal.material: flat monochrome linework; flatten palette gradients
lineart-minimal.image: one content-specific outline scene, never generic AI symbols

illust-2.5d.shape: one isometric angle with simplified geometric objects
illust-2.5d.radius: one small radius scale for supporting modules
illust-2.5d.shadow: limited soft depth under the primary illustration only
illust-2.5d.material: restrained 2.5D illustration, never mixed with glass
illust-2.5d.image: content-specific objects and scenes; no generic chip, shield, or robot

card-modern.shape: asymmetric modular blocks with one clipped-corner signature
card-modern.shadow: none or one faint background-tinted shadow
card-modern.material: flat modular surfaces, not a card wall
card-modern.image: real screenshot, product image, or content-specific linework
card-modern.annotation: short direct labels; no version stamps or decorative pills

hud-frame.shape: square technical frames and orthogonal connectors
hud-frame.radius: square or one very-small radius scale
hud-frame.shadow: no drop shadow; focal glow only
hud-frame.material: dark technical wireframe and restrained luminance
hud-frame.image: one content-specific wireframe object; no unrelated sci-fi scenery
hud-frame.annotation: only source-backed technical labels, never fictional telemetry

swiss-grid.shape: square geometry on a rigorous 12-column grid
swiss-grid.material: flat pure fields; flatten palette gradients
swiss-grid.image: square crop aligned to the grid
swiss-grid.annotation: direct typographic labels on grid lines

industrial-diagram.shape: square engineering modules and orthogonal connectors
industrial-diagram.radius: square or one very-small radius scale
industrial-diagram.material: flat engineering diagram; flatten palette gradients
industrial-diagram.image: source-backed equipment or scene with technical annotation
industrial-diagram.annotation: compact engineering labels with no fictional parameters

product-evidence.shape: one dominant evidence frame plus a narrow annotation rail
product-evidence.radius: square or one small radius scale
product-evidence.shadow: none or one faint background-tinted separation shadow
product-evidence.material: flat evidence surface; flatten palette gradients
product-evidence.image: source-backed screenshot, photo, diagram, or visibly labeled conceptual scene
product-evidence.annotation: direct factual callouts plus a provenance band when required
